clips.title: The story
paras: The Hunt Continues is an early rite of passage assigned by Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache. It tasks aspiring hunters with gathering mountain cougar pelts from the southern hills to clothe the tribe's children and mend their tents.

In Camp Narache, young hunters are taught that taking a beast is never an idle pursuit or a search for trophies. Grull Hawkwind charges fledgling adventurers with venturing into the southern hills of Red Cloud Mesa to track down mountain cougars. Rather than proving martial prowess alone, the task emphasizes responsibility to the community, showing that true hunters must provide essential provisions for their people.

Life on the mesa demands durable materials to withstand the open elements. Grull explains that the cougar hides are urgently needed to sew clothing for the tribe's children and to mend worn hide tents throughout Camp Narache. Proving oneself capable of securing these prized pelts earns the gratitude of the elders, and Grull promises to bring word of the hunter's selfless contributions directly to his father, Chief Hawkwind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A tauren skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.
Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The traveler of Narache thank you for these provisions, friend. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
